description.value: Vehicle-accessible forest campground perched above a 225-metre sandy beach on Mill Bay inlet, with sweeping views to the Gulf Islands and Mt. Baker; popular and crowded in summer, with a steep trail linking the campground to the beach.

address.value: 13 Bamberton Rd, Mill Bay, BC V8H 1B7, Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms Bamberton is an active BC Parks frontcountry campground (~53 sites per OSM capacity tag) on southern Vancouver Island, ~45 km north of Victoria off Highway 1 near Mill Bay. The BC Parks frontcountry reservations page confirms the reservation system applies to over 110 BC Parks campgrounds including this type, supporting reservations_accepted=true. No cyclist-specific amenities (hiker/biker sites, showers, food on-site, etc.) are mentioned anywhere in the website content, so those remain null. The OSM community tag lists 'Sidney,' but the park is clearly near Mill Bay — flagged as a concern.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'Sidney' but the park is located near Mill Bay, ~45 km north of Victoria; Sidney is on the Saanich Peninsula and is geographically incorrect for this park.

OSM phone (+1-877-559-2115) could not be confirmed via the website; BC Parks general contact page lists different numbers (1-800-689-9025 toll-free). The OSM number may belong to the park operator K2 Cowichan Park Services Ltd. or a reservation line — not verified.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Established 53-site provincial park campground directly on the Highway 1 / Malahat Drive corridor — one of the primary cycling routes on southern Vancouver Island — making it a clear practical benefit for touring cyclists.

wow_evidence: 225-metre sandy beach on Mill Bay inlet, with sweeping views to the Gulf Islands and Mt. Baker
